blind.description: A classical ornate stone garden bench featuring a solid stone seat slab, an arched stone backrest with a carved decorative groove, scrolled armrests with spiral volutes, and two heavy carved support legs resting flat on the ground. The material resembles weathered beige/cream limestone or sandstone with patches of green moss/lichen weathering along crevices and top surfaces. Geometry is fully solid, closed, and cleanly modelled with no hovering fragments, holes, or melting artifacts.
blind.from_above: A rectangular stone bench outline showing the flat seat slab bordered by scrolled armrests on the left and right, and an arched stone backrest along the top edge, accented with green moss along the corners.
blind.height_vs_figure: The bench stands roughly waist-high to slightly below hip height of the figure (about 2.5 to 3 ft tall) and is roughly as wide as the figure is tall (around 5 to 5.5 ft wide).
